**What would you like?**
A clear description of the feature or improvement.

**Why**
The problem it solves or the workflow it improves.

**Alternatives**
Anything you have tried or considered.

**Scope check**
Uncork is for Mac gaming on Apple Silicon (storefronts and games). Requests outside
that (general Windows apps, non-gaming software) are unlikely to fit.
